correctness.rationale: Two translated orthonormal Fock jet clusters give Gram block [I C;C* I] with C=P_mD_rP_m, hence spectrum 1±σ_j(C); leakage A=(I−P_m)D_rP_m satisfies A*A=I−C*C. The m distinct leakage singular-value orders are extracted from the unique leading p×p exterior minor: rows m..m+p−1, columns m−p..m−1, of order r^{p²}, coefficient c_{m,p}=sqrt(prod_i (m+i)!/(m−p+i)!)*prod_i i!/(p+i)!. All other minors vanish at higher order and analytic Fock tails are controlled. Ratios of exterior norms give s_{m,p}~(c_{m,p}/c_{m,p−1})r^{2p−1}=γ_{m,p}r^{2p−1}; squaring/2 yields λ^-~γ²r^{4p−2}/2, sharp smallest λ and condition number. At m=2 direct singular values give exact λ_min=1−exp(−r²/2)(sqrt(4+r^4)+r²)/2. Independent mpmath displaced-monomial computations for m=1..4 at r=.035 checked all leading constants within ~0.13% and exact block identity. Only fixed-m local r→0 is proven.
residual_risks: Finite independent computations and package checkers are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
